scope: documentation plan; not a trainer configuration or Slurm launcher

assumptions.date_note: dated scenario; recalculate for actual GPU start

cost_rules: allocations are planning ceilings, not forecasts
benchmark, smoke, tuning and retry costs are included
charge allocated GPUs times allocation elapsed once per allocation
atomically reserve active job caps against the shared study balance
elapsed feasibility depends on data/phase critical path as well as total GPU-hours
base_objective: coordinate loss by default; any extra motion term must be explicit and shared by matched controls
readout_inputs: same observed deployment-style inputs; no artificial pretraining mask at frozen readout

default_update_budget.scope: profile and freeze shared supported budgets for other recipe types before final fitting

resource_fallback.policy: halve common update schedule from timing feasibility before outcome ranking; retain all recipes and seeds

optional_five_seed_counts.condition: declare before confirmation outputs and use same five seeds for every recipe

required_before_launch: reference admission and confirmation roster or development-only scope
loss coefficients and matched endpoint exposure
actual H100 stage timing and complete dependency forecast
primary contrast and secondary comparison hierarchy
profile_scope_note: 135 optimization phases cover final models only; additional attempts must be charged separately without double-counting allocation time
